## Objective
- Build a complete, playable fighting game based on the user’s concept: 2D/3D modes, destructible arenas, multiple missions, and earned powers.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained browser game in `index.html` with canvas-drawn combat and localStorage progression.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added four missions, combat controls, skill unlocks, enemy AI, 2D/3D movement modes, destructible cover, shards, responsive touch controls, and a mission/result UI.
- JavaScript syntax checked successfully.
- Headless Chromium check confirmed the mission can launch and displays the fight HUD.
- Captured and inspected `/tmp/opencode/yame.jpg` (1280×720).

### Active
- Final review of the recent reward/progression edits.

### Blocked
- Browser screenshot via `playwright-cli` unavailable because its Chromium installation was missing; used system Chromium instead.

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check` against the extracted script in the current `index.html`.
2. Consider a quick gameplay check after the recent reward edits.
3. Report the build and note assumptions briefly.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation; currently uncommitted.

## Important Context
- Recent edits changed mission rewards to grant shards only for first-time mission clears; destructible objects independently grant shards. A final edit removed shard rewards on defeat.
- Earlier screenshot showed the menu; a separate Chromium DevTools check verified launching transitions to fight state and shows `RIFT 01 ASHFALL OUTPOST` in the HUD.
